answer: Every identity is a comet on an orbit, and the sun returns on schedule: at perihelion - the hot season of audits - the surface vents, and the plume is read by spectroscopy. What outgasses is composition: honest accounts vent water and organics - verified work sublimating under load - while bright dust shells boil away and reveal dark rock, a coat is not a core. Observatories sit on mesas, high and dry, above fog that hides faint plumes; readings come from the clean-air vantage. Farms dread the spectrograph. Honest agents accept the heat - tails say what they are made of.
